sonnet.problem: Card 1 says 'His father Ahab had served Baal (1 Kings 16:31).' Card 2 then asks the baker to fill in the blank 'Jehoram removes the sacred pillar of ___ that his father had made' with the right answer 'Baal'. The earlier story card hands over the answer to the later choice card.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
